name: Military Warfare Tycoon
desc:
Join the battle and build your private military base and get access to more than 20 guns and lots of vehicles! Don't forget to thumbs up and favorite the game if you like it! 

🎮 Military Warfare Tycoon is now also playable on console, mobile and tablet devices!

💰 Join the Saikou community to receive +5.000 starter cash! 
https://www.roblox.com/groups/3149674/Saikou

🚩 Completing missions give you in-game rewards, such as cash bonuses or items! All obtainable rewards can be found in the badge descriptions.

🎵 New music by Dommuss - On the Battlefield. Winner of the Saikou Fanart Contest 2023 🏆

⚠️ Exploiting, cheating, doxing, excessive insults, impersonating admins, wall glitching, and any Roblox ToS violation will result in a permanent ban. Our anti-cheat and moderators will catch you. To appeal a ban, please contact the game admins directly.
